profiles.name: Jimmy Puah Wee Tse
profiles.description: Jimmy Puah Wee Tse represents Tebrau, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. Affiliated with PKR.

profiles.name: Hassan Abdul Karim
profiles.description: Hassan Abdul Karim represents Pasir Gudang, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. Affiliated with PKR.

profiles.name: Suhaizan Kaiat
profiles.description: Suhaizan Kaiat represents Pulai, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. Affiliated with AMANAH.

milestones.title: Report RM40,000 in assistance for a Tebrau surau
milestones.description: The Prime Minister’s published Desa Mutiara Tebrau speech records Jimmy Puah’s RM40,000 contribution for a surau.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers only the reported contribution. The transcript does not establish the exact earlier handover date, the surau’s completed works or subsequent use of the funds.

milestones.title: Distribute back-to-school assistance to more than 100 Pulai students
milestones.description: Suhaizan’s service centre and TNB Johor Bahru delivered school-preparation support at the 6 January programme. TNB contributed RM10,000 and eligible recipients received RM150 redemption vouchers.
milestones.progress_note: Published 7 January about the previous day’s programme. Achieved covers the reported assistance round, jointly delivered with TNB; it does not establish universal eligibility coverage or later redemption totals.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
